verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Open my eyes, Lord
Help me to see Your face

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Open my eyes, Lord
Help me to see

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Open my ears, Lord
Help me to hear Your voice

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Open my ears, Lord
Help me to hear

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Open my heart, Lord
Help me to love like you

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Open my heart, Lord
Help me to love

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines:
I live within You
Deep in your heart, O Love

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines:
I live within you
Rest now in me
